Servo.description: Controls an RC servo on an ESP32. Create an instance, attach() it to a GPIO pin, then write() an angle or writeMicroseconds() a pulse width. Uses fixed-frequency PWM (50 Hz by default) through the ESP32's MCPWM or LEDC hardware, so it works on the pins that support PWM output.

attach.signature: int attach(int pin)  |  int attach(int pin, int min, int max)
attach.description: Attaches the servo to a GPIO pin using the next free PWM channel, and returns the channel number (or 0 on failure). The three-argument form also sets the minimum and maximum pulse widths in microseconds (enforced min 500, max 2500). On a classic ESP32 the recommended pins are 2, 4, 12-19, 21-23, 25-27, 32-33.

write.description: Sets the servo position. A value below 500 is treated as an angle in degrees (0 to 180); a value of 500 or more is treated as a pulse width in microseconds. Out-of-range values are clamped.

writeMicroseconds.description: Sets the servo pulse width directly in microseconds, clamped to the attached min/max. Use this when you want precise control past the 0-180 degree mapping.

read.description: Returns the last written position as an angle between 0 and 180 degrees.

readMicroseconds.description: Returns the last written pulse width in microseconds.

attached.description: Returns true if this servo is currently attached to a pin.

detach.description: Detaches the servo, freeing its pin and PWM channel for reuse.

setPeriodHertz.description: Sets the servo refresh frequency in hertz. Use 50 for standard hobby servos, or a higher value (some digital servos accept up to ~333 Hz). Call this before attach().

setTimerWidth.description: Sets the PWM timer resolution in bits (10 to 20; ESP32 only). The current pulse width is recomputed as a side effect.

readTimerWidth.description: Returns the PWM timer resolution in bits (ESP32 only).

writeTicks.description: Writes the raw PWM tick count, the smallest increment the servo hardware can resolve. Most code uses write() or writeMicroseconds() instead.

readTicks.description: Returns the last written pulse width in raw PWM ticks.

release.description: Releases the servo, stopping the PWM signal on its pin without fully detaching it.
